articleTitle: DARPA's programs on photonic technologies and applications
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: This talk will present an overview of DARPA/MTO's many challenging programs in the area of photonic technologies (e.g. nanophotonics, silicon photonics and photonic integration) as well as photonic applications in communication, interconnection, switching and routing.

articleTitle: Optical interconnect demonstrator with embedded waveguides and butt-coupled optoelectronic modules
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Building blocks and experimental results of an optical card-backplane-card link with waveguides embedded into the boards and butt-coupled optoelectronic modules are presented. Important next steps for acceptance of the technology by system developers are listed.

articleTitle: Phase signal embedment in densely frequency-multiplexed coherent neural networks
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We propose a coherent neural network whose synaptic weights are embedded densely in volume hologram using a semiconductor laser so that the behavior is controlled by direct lightwave carrier-frequency modulation. A frequency-dependent learning obeys the complex-valued Hebbian rule. Experiments demonstrate that the system learns different output phase values dependently on the carrier frequency.

articleTitle: Scaling VCSEL reliability up to 250Terabits/s of system bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We evaluate VCSEL reliability for next-generation High Productivity Computers in which several hundreds of terabits of bandwidth are envisioned. An empirical relationship for VCSEL scaling versus bit rate and aperture is presented in order to explore reliability of VCSEL-based links. Reliability is found to degrade with aperture with a fourth order power law dependence. VSCEL sparing, water-cooling and redundancy though percentage of link failures are analyzed.

articleTitle: New-generation interconnect
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: A new-generation interconnect for optical backplane systems based on printed circuits board is presented for transmitting data via integrated multimode polymer optical waveguides both on electro-optical transmitter/receiver processing boards and on optical backplane board. Different developments concerning this system such as optical waveguide technology, transmitter/receiver module activities, and optical interconnect/coupling concepts are discussed.

articleTitle: Improvement on recording density in reflection-type holographic memory with random phase shift multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Recording density of a reflection-type holographic memory system can be improved by use of random phase shift multiplexing. A recording interval of 1.0 ¿m was achieved in a 0.5 mm thick Fe:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>.

articleTitle: Board integrated micro-optics for divergence management in opto-electronic interconnect systems
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: In order to reduce the divergence of high power VCSELs for the High-speed Optoelectronic Memory System optical interconnect project, the integration of refractive micro-lenses into a Multi-Chip Module base board is examined.

articleTitle: Encapsulated microsphere arrays for applications in photonic circuits
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: This paper describes the fabrication, characterization and spectroscopic properties of novel structures made from prearranged circuits of optically coupled polystyrene microspheres in a robust elastomeric polymer.

articleTitle: Demonstration of all-photonic code conversion in a semiconductor fiber ring laser for OCDMA networks
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We demonstrate all-photonic code conversion for OCDMA network applications based on cross-gain modulation in a semiconductor fiber ring laser. The code converter translates weight four spectral sequences and is capable of providing 2R regeneration.

articleTitle: Merging stacked and planar-integrated free-space optics to build a 3-D optical multilayer
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Stacked and planar-integrated free-space optics are well-known concepts for building compact free-space optics. Their combination offers additional degrees of freedom for systems design. We discuss the possibilities and present a three-dimensional optical interface-module in a memory-bus-interconnect.

articleTitle: Half-horn and parabola shaped electro-optic beam deflectors
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We report the design of two electro-optic deflectors. The half-horn and parabola shaped EO scanners provide deflection angles of 2.5°and 3.22° degrees. These are the largest angles reported to date for bulk effect EO scanners.

articleTitle: A simulation method for quantum algorithm using optical array logic
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: A simulator for exponential function in Shor's quantum algorithm is presented. It is based on optical array logic (OAL) which is one of paradigm for digital optical computing. In the method, a quantum statement with superposition and entanglement is represented by two-dimensional spatial pattern. Parallel processing set by OAL simulates quantum properties.

articleTitle: Solutions to optoelectronic interconnect problems
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Optoelectronic bonding has been performed onto sample MCMs, which are to be used for optical testing on HOLMS demonstrator. The photodiodes and VCSELs were successfully bonded, but we experienced problems attaching the Mixed Signal chips.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of hyper-spectral volume holographic imaging using the slice-and-cascade method
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We present the analysis of rainbow-illumination volume holographic hyper-spectral imaging using a slice-and-cascade numerical method. The experiments are in good agreement with the simulations.

articleTitle: Dynamic optical memory based on light trapping in a ring resonator using asymmetric grating assisted codirectional couplers
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We present a systematic study of an asymmetric switchable grating enabling the coupling between a waveguide and a ring resonator. The ring can act as an optical memory or as a pulse retiming device.

articleTitle: A broadband PLL solution for burst-mode clock and data recovery in all-optical networks
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Fast phase-locking PLLs are proposed as a new solution for recovery of burst-mode data. Modeling and circuit implementation have demonstrated phase-lock times on the order of tens of bits for data recovery at OC-48 rates.

articleTitle: Rigorous analysis of strong spherical wave gratings using a slice-and-cascade approach
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We present a numerical approach to computing diffraction from strong holograms of arbitrary fringe shape, e.g. plane-to-spherical. We compute the angular, shift and wavelength Bragg selectivities and compare with coupled wave and weak diffraction approaches.

articleTitle: Optical delay lines formed by circuits of spherical cavities with coupled whispering gallery modes
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We propose a novel concept of optical delay lines where the tunable delay can be achieved by controlling the inter-resonator gap sizes in circuits of optically coupled microspheres.

articleTitle: Dispersion-managed (3+1)-D optical solitons for ultrafast switching and wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Dispersion management of bulk nonlinear materials for generating (3+1)-D optical soli-tons is achieved by use of negative dispersive mirrors. Ultrafast switching and wavelength conversion based on these dispersion managed solitons are proposed and demonstrated numerically.

articleTitle: Free space adaptive optical interconnect, using a ferroelectric liquid crystal SLM for beam steering
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: A free-space, board-to-board, adaptive optical interconnect demonstrator has been developed. Binary phase gratings displayed on a Ferroelectric Liquid Crystal Spatial Light Modulator are used to maintain data transfer at 1.25Gbps, given varying optical misalignment.

articleTitle: Architectural limits on optical highway interconnected parallel processing
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Optics are often suggested for interconnecting parallel processors. The minimum size of such a computer was found to be sixteen for a reducing sum and six for a fast Fourier transform due to architectural limits.

articleTitle: PAM-4 signaling over VCSELs using 0.13 μm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We present results for VCSEL based links operating PAM-4 signaling using a commercial 0.13μm CMOS technology. We perform a complete link analysis of the Bit Error Rate, Q factor, random and deterministic jitter by measuring waterfall curves versus margins in time and amplitude We demonstrate that VCSEL based PAM -4 can match or even improve performance over binary signaling under conditions of bandwidth limited 100meter multi-mode optical link at 5Gbps. We present the first sensitivity measurements for optical PAM-4 and compare it with binary signaling.

articleTitle: Limits to photonics for information
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: The talk will discuss some of the limits we know, and some we don't, and how these can influence what we can or should do in using photonics to help handle information.

articleTitle: Performance analysis for a waveguide based optical interconnect system
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: An analytical model for inter-channel crosstalk in a waveguide based optical interconnect system is established. The results show the dependence of the performance on the loss of the link and the dominant noise.

articleTitle: Reprogrammable optical phase array (ROPA) for use in an agile all-photonic network
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: The design and simulation of a 1×N optical switch is presented. Sub-¿s switching is achieved through a voltage-controlled optical phase array. Electrode voltages are provided by a high-voltage CMOS chip. Switching angles are within 2°.

articleTitle: 2D optical interconnects between CMOS ICs
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We describe an optical interconnect demonstrator in which 2D fiber ribbons directly interconnect digital CMOS ICs with flip-chip mounted VCSEL and detector arrays. Novel approaches are demonstrated for the optical interface to the CMOS package.

articleTitle: New optics using negative refraction
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We summarize the benefits that negative index materials (NIMs), realizable in artificially constructed metamaterials, can have on both geometrical and wave optics. NIMs may lead to novel or improved future optical devices.

articleTitle: Optical image inversion and edge detection based on Vertical Cavity Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers (VCSOAs)
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We demonstrate optical image inversion and edge detection by employing a VCSOA in the focal plane of a 4-f optical system to manipulate both phase and amplitude of the zero-order spatial frequency component of images.

articleTitle: High-bandwidth, unity probability-of-intercept RF spectrum analyzer based on spectral hole burning
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We perform 20-GHz spectrum analysis with unity probability-of-intercept by burning holes into a spectral-hole-burning crystal with an RF-modulated laser and probing the altered absorption profile with a chirped laser.

articleTitle: Dynamically adjustable annular laser trapping for sperm chemotaxis study
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: A diameter-adjustable annular laser trapping system based on axicons was designed for sperm chemotactaxis and fertilizability characterization. Experiment on microspheres testified the feasibility and performance of the system and was consistent with theoretical expectation.

articleTitle: Optofluidics
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Optofluidics seek to take advantage of recent advancements in micro- and nano-scale fluidics to deliver liquids directly into the optical structures thereby enabling a new class of tunable optical devices.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic memory-based computation using optical near-field interactions
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a memory-based computation architecture combining data summation and broadcast mechanisms using optical near-field interactions between quantum dots, which will allow high-density integration beyond the diffraction-limit of light.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional optical recording in a human fingernail
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Optical storage inside a human fingernail is performed. A bit is recorded by irradiating of a femtosecond laser pulse and the bit is read by use of increased fluorescence at the formed bit.

articleTitle: Optical image processing by use of an optoelectronic feedback system with an electronic distortion correction
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We demonstrate that optical image processing based on a spontaneous optical pattern formation from an initial seed optical pattern in an optoelectronic feedback system with electronic distortion correction.

articleTitle: Doppler LIDAR processing in spatial spectral holograms
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We present a novel technique for range-Doppler lidar processing which uses the parallel recording of Doppler-matched, high-bandwidth (> 10 GHz), spatial-spectral holographic gratings, which are subsequently read with a chirped laser and post-processed.

articleTitle: Laser writing of tapers in polymer
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: A fabrication method for laser writing a polymer taper by accelerating the laser beam across the polymer is described. This taper gradually varies in the horizontal and vertical dimensions and is similar to fibre tapers.

articleTitle: Parallel fabrication of photonic crystals (PC) using interference lithography for integrated waveguide-PC devices
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Multiple exposure interference lithography is a promising way to fabricate areas of photonic crystals areas lithographically mapped for easy integration with conventional waveguides or optical devices. Preliminary results on fabrication of square PCs are reported.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a broadband microwave imager using spectral hole burning as a narrowband image sieve
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We present broadband microwave imaging that uses Fourier optical beamforming to project squinted broadband images into a spectral hole burning material from which independent narrowband images are read, de-squinted, and summed into broadband microwave images.

articleTitle: Analysis of a WDM packet switch with a reduced set of limited-range wavelength converters
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We analyze the performance of a packet switch in a wavelength division multiplexed network employing reduced sets of limited-range wavelength converters. Optimal operation is achieved by trading off conversion range and number of converters.

articleTitle: Diffraction-limited impulse response image reconstruction with a single imaging pixel
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: In this paper, we will discuss two techniques to reconstruct diffraction-limited impulse response images by sub-pixel shifting the photodetector array and measuring the signal from a specific large area photodetector pixel.

articleTitle: GPC-based optical manipulation
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: The Generalized Phase Contrast (GPC) method enables conversion of phase-only modulation to highly photon efficient light distributions. GPC targets a number of applications such as interactive optical manipulation, wavefront sensing, optical encryption and integrated micro-optics.

articleTitle: On the suitability of fiber optical parametric amplifiers for agile photonic networks
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We study the gain tilt and gain transients of fiber optical parametric amplifiers to determine their suitability and potential use in reconfigurable multi-wavelength WDM photonic networks.

articleTitle: Asynchronous stream cipher system using digital smart pixel arrays
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: An optoelectronic parallel processing system for asynchronous stream cipher has been constructed to demonstrate potential capability of free-space optical interconnections. Two digital smart pixel arrays are employed for generation of pseudorandom patterns and encryption.

articleTitle: Feasible light fields in three-dimensional space
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: The author investigate the synthesis of light fields in 3D domains by means of a singular value decomposition of the objective signal. The number of effective 3D degrees of freedom determines the feasible fields.

articleTitle: All-optical CDMA and switching
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: This paper proposes and demonstrates all-optical CDMA and switching technologies. In particular, we investigate and achieve optical CDMA encoding and decoding on integrated InP microsystems. Experimental results indicate successful optical CDMA encoding and detections.

articleTitle: Scalable optical interconnection network for parallel and distributed computing
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: In this paper, a high-performance, scalable, parallel computing system called RAPID is designed using switchless, passive optical interconnect technology. RAPID outperforms current electrical multiprocessor systems by significantly decreasing the remote memory access latency.

articleTitle: Novel slab lens based on artificial graded index medium
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: In this paper we present a novel slab lens based on artificial graded index medium. The lens is realized by etching 1-D subwavelength gratings into a high index slab waveguide to achieve the desired effective index distribution. A graded index profile is achieved by gradually modifying the duty cycle of the grating along the horizontal axis, whereas the beam is confined in the vertical direction by the slab waveguide. The proposed device is very attractive for various applications, including mode matching, coupling, guiding, imaging, optical signal processing, while offering the intrinsic advantages of monolithic, on-chip integration. The device is analyzed analytically numerically.

articleTitle: Wavelength division multiplexer based on photonic crystal filters integrated into silicon-on-insulator waveguides
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: A photonic crystal (PC)-based FP filter in silicon-on-insulator (SOI) is designed and simulated by finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) approach. The result is compared to a fabricated PC filter. A wavelength division multiplexer (WDM) component occupying only 500 ¿m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> based on this filter is designed and simulated.

articleTitle: Implementation of quantum computation algorithm based on spatial coding
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Spatial coding, which is an effective digital optical computing technique, is studied as an efficient implementation method of quantum computation algorithms. In the proposed scheme, quantum information is represented by intensity and phase of the elemental cells. We confirmed correct operation of the quantum teleportation algorithm by computer simulation. We also demonstrated an optical implementation of quantum gates experimentally.

articleTitle: Electrically injected photonic crystal lasers
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Experimental characteristics high-Q single-cell photonic crystal laser modes are discussed. Especially the resonant mode with a central node, where the introduction of a small electrical wire at the center of the resonator does not produce appreciable optical losses, is investigated.

articleTitle: Laser tweezer controlled optical spatial filtering
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We present an optical spatial filtering device, integrated into a microfluidic system, and controlled by a laser tweezer. Optical spatial filtering is achieved through automatic alignment in three-dimensions to the focus of the laser beam.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal biosensors
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Photonic crystals have been used to produce a general-purpose disposable plastic biosensor platform for performing many types of biochemical and cellular assays without the use of fluorescent labels for applications in pharmaceutical research.

articleTitle: High performance holographic data storage
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: Polytopic-angle multiplexing implemented in a phase conjugate architecture enables high-density storage. Using blue media, 100 Gb/in2 density, an operational prototype, and a roadmap to 1.6 TB per disk are presented.

articleTitle: Spatial position detection of three-dimensional object using complex amplitude derived from Fourier transform profilometry
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: The spatial position detection by the 3D object recognition method based on the Fourier transform profilometry is discussed. The exact displacement along the depth direction can be derived from the phase of the correlation output.

articleTitle: Comparison of least-square equalization and iterative decision feedback in page-oriented optical data storage
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We compare bit-error rate in least square adaptive equalization and iterative decision feedback data detection methods for volumetric (3D) page-oriented optical data storage (PODS) systems with extreme intersymbol interference (ISI) in novel hexagonal coordinate systems.

articleTitle: Optical accumulator for signal processing
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: An optical fiber accumulator is designed and experimentally demonstrated for different accumulation rates. The design is based on an optical-fiber loop resonator. Excellent agreement between theory and experiment is obtained for 1.8 MHz sampling rate.

articleTitle: Parallel three-step-phase-shifting digital holography
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We propose a parallel phase-shifting digital holography as a technique capable of noiseless instantaneous applications for three-dimensional objects such as measurement and object recognition. The technique carries out the three-step-phase-shifting at a time using a phase-shifting array device located in the reference beam. The device is an array of three kinds of phase retarders. We numerically simulate the reconstructed image by the technique. The result of the simulation agrees well with that of the conventional phase-shifting digital holography, and it is superior to the result obtained by the conventional digital holography using a Fresnel transform alone, which is another technique capable of instantaneous applications.

articleTitle: Computer generated volume holograms: Design and fabrication
publicationTitle: 2005 OSA Topical Meeting on Information Photonics (IP)
abstract: We discuss coding techniques for computer-generated volume holograms and present experimental results of holograms embedded in glass fabricated with a femtosecond laser.
